import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import textwrap

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

source_path = Path('/app/benchmark/source_data.json')
data = json.loads(source_path.read_text())

# Helpers
def period_to_date(period):
    year, half = period.split('-H')
    month = 1 if half == '1' else 7
    return datetime(int(year), month, 1)

def year_to_date(year):
    return datetime(int(year), 7, 1)

# Data
tariffs = data['tariff_rates']['data']
tariff_dates = [period_to_date(row['period']) for row in tariffs]
us_tariff = [row['us_tariff_on_china'] for row in tariffs]
china_tariff = [row['china_tariff_on_us'] for row in tariffs]

trade = data['bilateral_trade']['data']
trade_dates = [year_to_date(row['year']) for row in trade]
total_trade = [row['total_bilateral'] for row in trade]

shares = data['supply_chain_share']['data']
share_dates = [year_to_date(row['year']) for row in shares]
china_share = [row['china'] for row in shares]
vietnam_share = [row['vietnam'] for row in shares]
india_share = [row['india'] for row in shares]
alt_share = [row['vietnam'] + row['india'] for row in shares]

policy_events = data['policy_events']['data']
# Curated labels from source events to avoid crowding while retaining key milestones.
label_map = {
    '2017-08-14': 'Section 301\ninvestigation',
    '2018-07-06': 'List 1\ntariffs',
    '2018-09-24': 'List 3\n$200B',
    '2019-05-10': 'List 3\nraised',
    '2020-01-15': 'Phase One\ndeal',
    '2021-10-04': 'USTR review\nframework',
    '2024-05-14': 'Biden 301\nraises',
}
key_events = [event for event in policy_events if event['date'] in label_map]

# Editorial palette
navy = '#1B365D'
red = '#B74E4A'
blue = '#2F6F9F'
teal = '#2C9C8D'
saffron = '#E0A43A'
gray = '#6C757D'
light_grid = '#D7DEE8'
panel_bg = '#F7F8FA'
shade = '#F1D9D6'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'axes.edgecolor': '#A8B0BA',
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.color': '#344054',
    'ytick.color': '#344054',
    'text.color': '#1F2937',
    'axes.labelcolor': '#344054',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10), dpi=180, facecolor='white')
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, height_ratios=[1.05, 1.0, 1.2], hspace=0.13)
axes = [fig.add_subplot(gs[i, 0]) for i in range(3)]

start = datetime(2016, 1, 1)
end = datetime(2024, 12, 31)
escalation_start = datetime(2018, 7, 1)
escalation_end = datetime(2020, 2, 14)

for ax in axes:
    ax.set_facecolor(panel_bg)
    ax.axvspan(escalation_start, escalation_end, color=shade, alpha=0.55, zorder=0)
    ax.grid(axis='y', color=light_grid, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    ax.set_xlim(start, end)

# Panel 1: Tariffs as step escalation
ax = axes[0]
ax.step(tariff_dates, us_tariff, where='post', color=red, linewidth=2.8, label='US tariff on Chinese goods')
ax.step(tariff_dates, china_tariff, where='post', color=navy, linewidth=2.8, label='China tariff on US goods')
ax.scatter(tariff_dates, us_tariff, s=22, color=red, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.6)
ax.scatter(tariff_dates, china_tariff, s=22, color=navy, zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.6)
ax.set_ylim(0, 29)
ax.set_ylabel('Average effective tariff rate (%)')
ax.text(datetime(2016, 2, 1), 26.8, '1  Tariff escalation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=navy)
ax.annotate('Peak 2024\nUS: 25.4%\nChina: 23.1%', xy=(datetime(2024,1,1), 25.4), xytext=(datetime(2023,2,1), 27.7),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=gray, lw=0.9), fontsize=9, ha='left', va='top',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', fc='white', ec='#CCD3DB', alpha=0.92))
ax.legend(loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.22, 1.02), ncol=2, frameon=False, handlelength=2.8)

# Policy markers on top panel
marker_colors = {'investigation': '#7C3AED', 'tariff': red, 'deal': teal, 'review': saffron}
y_positions = [10.5, 14.5, 19.2, 24.0, 16.3, 12.0, 21.6]
for event, y in zip(key_events, y_positions):
    date = datetime.fromisoformat(event['date'])
    ax.axvline(date, color=marker_colors[event['category']], linewidth=1.1, alpha=0.65, linestyle='--', zorder=1)
    ax.text(date, y, label_map[event['date']], rotation=0, fontsize=8.1, ha='center', va='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.22', fc='white', ec=marker_colors[event['category']], lw=0.8, alpha=0.95))

# Panel 2: Bilateral trade volume
ax = axes[1]
bar_colors = ['#99AEC4' if year_to_date(row['year']) < escalation_start else '#7898B6' for row in trade]
for i, row in enumerate(trade):
    if row['year'] in (2019, 2020, 2023, 2024):
        bar_colors[i] = '#C78582'
ax.bar(trade_dates, total_trade, width=250, color=bar_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, label='Total bilateral trade')
ax.plot(trade_dates, total_trade, color=navy, linewidth=2.2, marker='o', markersize=4, label='Trajectory')
ax.set_ylim(0, 760)
ax.set_ylabel('Total bilateral trade (USD billions)')
ax.text(datetime(2016, 2, 1), 705, '2  Trade volume shock and partial recoveries', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=navy)
for year, value, label, offset in [(2018, 659.8, '2018 peak\n$659.8B', 32), (2019, 558.6, '2019 tariff dip\n$558.6B', -70), (2022, 690.6, '2022 rebound\n$690.6B', 34), (2024, 539.7, '2024 estimate\n$539.7B', -62)]:
    ax.annotate(label, xy=(year_to_date(year), value), xytext=(year_to_date(year), value + offset),
                ha='center', va='bottom' if offset > 0 else 'top', fontsize=8.6,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=gray, lw=0.8),
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.22', fc='white', ec='#CCD3DB', alpha=0.92))

# Panel 3: Supply-chain shares
ax = axes[2]
ax.plot(share_dates, china_share, color=red, linewidth=3.0, marker='o', markersize=4.8, label='China')
ax.plot(share_dates, vietnam_share, color=teal, linewidth=2.4, marker='o', markersize=4, label='Vietnam')
ax.plot(share_dates, india_share, color=saffron, linewidth=2.4, marker='o', markersize=4, label='India')
ax.plot(share_dates, alt_share, color=blue, linewidth=2.7, marker='o', markersize=4.2, linestyle='--', label='Vietnam + India')
ax.fill_between(share_dates, vietnam_share, india_share, color='#BFE5DF', alpha=0.16)
ax.set_ylim(0, 24)
ax.set_ylabel('Share of total US goods imports (%)')
ax.set_xlabel('Year')
ax.text(datetime(2016, 2, 1), 22.2, '3  Supply-chain diversion in US import shares', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=navy)
ax.annotate('China share falls\n21.2% → 12.8%', xy=(year_to_date(2024), 12.8), xytext=(datetime(2022,10,1), 17.0),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=red, lw=1.0), fontsize=9, color='#5F2522', ha='left',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', fc='white', ec='#D7AAA7', alpha=0.94))
ax.annotate('Vietnam + India nearly doubles\n4.9% → 8.3%', xy=(year_to_date(2024), 8.3), xytext=(datetime(2020,6,1), 10.8),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', color=blue, lw=1.0), fontsize=9, color=navy, ha='left',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', fc='white', ec='#AFC8DB', alpha=0.94))
ax.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.20), ncol=4, frameon=False, handlelength=2.8)

# Shared x-axis formatting
for ax in axes[:-1]:
    ax.tick_params(labelbottom=False)
for ax in axes:
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.YearLocator())
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y'))

# Global policy period annotation
axes[0].text(datetime(2018, 9, 1), 1.2, 'Peak escalation window', fontsize=9, color='#7A3B37',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', fc='#F8E6E4', ec='none', alpha=0.9))

# Title, subtitle, footnote
fig.suptitle('US–China Trade War Dynamics: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply-Chain Diversion (2016–2024)',
             x=0.055, y=0.975, ha='left', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color=navy)
fig.text(0.055, 0.943,
         'Stepwise tariff increases coincide with a bilateral trade dip and a post-2018 acceleration in Vietnam and India import shares.',
         ha='left', fontsize=11, color='#475467')

# Consolidated event category legend
category_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color=marker_colors['investigation'], lw=1.4, ls='--', label='Investigation'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=marker_colors['tariff'], lw=1.4, ls='--', label='Tariff action'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=marker_colors['deal'], lw=1.4, ls='--', label='Deal'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=marker_colors['review'], lw=1.4, ls='--', label='Review'),
    Patch(facecolor=shade, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.55, label='Peak escalation window'),
]
fig.legend(handles=category_handles, loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(0.965, 0.958), ncol=5, frameon=False, fontsize=9, handlelength=2.0, columnspacing=1.1)

fig.text(0.055, 0.025,
         'Source: task source_data.json. Tariffs are trade-weighted average effective rates; 2024 tariff data is H1 and trade is estimated. Units: percent and USD billions.',
         ha='left', fontsize=8.5, color='#667085')

plt.subplots_adjust(left=0.075, right=0.97, top=0.90, bottom=0.12)
output = Path('/app/output/result.png')
fig.savefig(output, dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close(fig)
print(output)
